meta.name: pm-skill-creator
meta.description: Design a new PM skill through guided conversation. Use when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话将想法转化为合规技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有原始内容或想法，想把它塑造成一个合规的技能。
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw ideas into compliant skills through guided conversation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过对话引导你设计一个新的 PM 技能。它会问最多 5 个问题，然后生成一份完整的 SKILL.md 草稿。
howto.when: 当你有原始内容或想法，想把它整理成一个符合仓库规范的技能时，可以触发这个技能。

say.text: 帮我设计一个技能，把定价层级框架变成技能。
say.note: Claude 会从你的框架开始，逐步引导你完成设计。

say.text: 我有一些工作坊笔记，想做成一个技能。
say.note: Claude 会询问笔记内容，帮你确定技能类型和结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through designing a new PM skill via conversation. It asks up to 5 adaptive questions, then generates a complete SKILL.md draft.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you have raw content or an idea and want to shape it into a compliant skill.

say_en.text: Help me design a skill from my pricing-tiers framework.
say_en.note: Claude starts from your framework and guides you through the process.

say_en.text: I have workshop notes and want to turn them into a skill.
say_en.note: Claude asks about the notes and helps determine skill type and structure.
